notes.title: Play Test Announcement
notes.content:
First off, a massive THANK YOU to everyone for your support so far! Developing this game has been an incredible journey, full of ups, downs, and learning moments. A special shout-out to the "voices in my head" (aka my Discord crew) for keeping me sane... or at least keeping things entertaining while I ran on 1 shared brain cell. If you want to see the madness in action, come hang out on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/Chris_W_2k5]my Twitch[/url] channel, where I stream my development process. Great music, good vibes, and lots of chaotic moments guaranteed—so drop by and follow!

[h1]Introduction to Fulfillment Center Simulator[/h1]
If you haven’t heard about Fulfillment Center Simulator yet, let me introduce you to your next tycoon obsession!

Inspired by hits like Supermarket Simulator and TCG Card Shop Simulator, this warehouse management game invites you to build your logistics empire from the ground up. The idea was born during one of Venalis’ streams, where a casual conversation sparked a vision. I was working on another project at the time, but as soon as Venalis pitched this concept, I reached out—and with his blessing, Fulfillment Center Simulator came to life.

Step into the role of a warehouse manager and tackle the challenges of running a fulfillment business. Handle client orders, optimize your inventory, and grow your reputation in a dynamic renown system. Build and maintain relationships with clients, suppliers, shippers, and advertisers to transform your humble operation into a logistics powerhouse.

[h1]Let’s Get to the Good Stuff![/h1]

[list]  
[h3]Save the Dates:[/h3]  
The calendar’s tight, but I’ve nailed down some important milestones to share with you all! Mark these down, and let’s make them count.  

[expand type=spoiler expanded=false]  
[b][url=#playtest]Playtest #3:[/url][/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]When:[/b] January 18th - 25th  
[*] [b]Who:[/b] Everyone!  
[*] [b]Where:[/b] Right here on Steam!  
[*] [b]Why It Matters:[/b] This is your chance get the demo for release! Your feedback will make all the difference!  
[/list]  
[/expand]  

[*] [h3][url=#mapupdate]New Map Announcement: Alphabet City[/url][/h3]  
[*] [h3][url=#lore]A Peek at the Lore[/url][/h3]  
[*] [h3][url=#future]Future Plans and Ideas[/url][/h3]  
[/list]

[h1=lore]The Backstory[/h1]  
As a longtime fan of RP (Role Play) games—be it GTA V, Atlas, Conan, or whatever caught my interest—I’ve created and carried unique characters across various worlds.  

[h2]Meet Rob:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]The Origin Story:[/b] Rob grew up in Alphabet City before moving to Boston. Later, he returned to Alphabet City, with no place to stay but his Uncle Paxton’s rundown shed. A bottle of rum and free labor secured Rob a roof over his head.  
[/list]  

[h2]Prologue [Demo]:[/h2]  
When Uncle Paxton had to “take care of business down south,” he left Rob with $10,000, one pallet of salt, and some vague advice: “Don’t burn the place down, and you can keep the profits. I’ll be back in 3 days.”  

[h1]What’s New Since the Last Update?[/h1]  
We’ve made tons of progress! The map has undergone a massive overhaul (more details below), and I’ve been fine-tuning the backend for better performance and multiplayer functionality. Networking replication has been a steep learning curve, but I’m determined to make this game as smooth as possible!  

[h1=mapupdate]Welcome to Alphabet City![/h1]  
The game now takes place in Alphabet City, with Uncle Paxton’s shack situated on the outskirts at the corner of Dark St. and [??] Ave. It’s a prime spot for expanding your Fulfillment Center empire!  

The core block will remain consistent, but you can expect plenty of updates as I fine-tune the environment.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AABEEPW.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vezMjWc.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3CAmZuF.jpeg[/img]

[h1=playtest]What to Expect During the Playtest[/h1]  
The tutorial system is getting a complete overhaul to make onboarding intuitive and engaging. Here’s where I need your help during the playtest:  

[h2]Goals:[/h2]  
[h3]Gameplay Basics[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Ensure players understand the game’s core mechanics, from starting their day to shipping orders.  
[/list]  
[h3]Orders and Supplies[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Test the process of managing orders and re-stocking your Fulfillment Center.  
[/list]  
[h3]Contacts and Finances[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Verify renown distribution with clients, shippers, and suppliers.  
[*] Make sure you don’t run out of money too quickly!  
[/list]  
[h1=future]Looking Ahead[/h1]  
Here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon for Fulfillment Center Simulator:  
[list]  
[*] Warehouse expansions  
[*] New shipping windows and vehicles  
[*] Character customization  
[*] Map expansions  
[/list]  

There’s plenty more to come, but I’ll leave it here for now. If you’ve made it this far—thank you! You’re an absolute legend!

notes.title: THIRDY
notes.content:
[h1]The one with the multiplayer[/h1]*

[expand type=details expanded=false]
[list]
[*] [h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Entire Game Engine
  [*] FCS has been updated to Unreal Engine 5.5
[*] 
[/list]
[*] [h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam Integration
  [*] Stats are now being tracked for achievements and such
  [*] Online lobbies are being tested. However, they're...interesting.
[*] Shipping
  [*] Players can now request shipping for specific orders
  [*] WARNING: Requesting shipping is weird if the pallet has multiple orders. Only send multi-shipment orders at the end of the day (auto) or select ALL orders on the same pallet.  I.E. Pallet A has orders 1, 3 and 4. Make sure you request shipping for ALL THREE of those order ID's. Nothing will break, you'll just lose product.
[*] Changed which alert is shown when not enough money to purchase cart
[*] Computer screen no longer flashes every 1000ms (THANK THE TOQUE!) 
[*] Pallets can now be (un)wrapped
[*] Pallets now come from the suppliers wrapped
  [*] I suggest leaving them wrapped for safety's sake. Or don't Good luck.
[*] Ordering multiple products from the store will no longer place them one inside the other 
[*] New box models
[*] More cases per pallet
[*] New Pallet models have made their way into the system some how....hmm..strange.
[*] Pallets can now have multiple orders tied to them. They can only be assigned to the same customer. 
  [*] WARNING: Requesting shipping is weird if the pallet has multiple orders. Only send multi-shipment orders at the end of the day (auto) or select ALL orders on the same pallet.  I.E. Pallet A has orders 1, 3 and 4. Make sure you request shipping for ALL THREE of those order ID's. Nothing will break, you'll just lose product. It's said twice because it's important :)
[*] Time no longer stops at the end of the day. It will continue till midnight then stop. As of right now, products won't come in after the end of the day.
[/list]
[*] [h2]Map Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Gutter.
  [*] Working on a new side activity.
[/list]
[*] [h2]Misc. Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You're cute. But that's not a change. 
[/list]
[*] [h2]Bugs Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [u]CURRENTLY UNTRACKED BECAUSE THERE'S A LOT OF THEM PROBABLY. [/u]
[*] Except this one: Fixed an issue where pallets weren't being loaded from save properly
[*] ...and this one: Fixed an issue where loading from the start menu wasn't loading properly
[/list]
[/list]
[/expand]

*vaguely...
